function.description: Fetches the count of interfaces that are associated with at least one tag. A tag is a user-defined or system-defined construct to group resources. When an interface is tagged, it is called a member of the tag.
function.name: api_retrieveTheCountOfInterfacesThatAreAssociatedWithAt_6c330a1b

responses.description: Reports a count, for example, a total count of records in a given resource.
